name: Remove Fatigue, Greater
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level alchemist 3, bloodlord 3, cleric/oracle 3, druid 3, inquisitor 3, paladin 2, shaman 3

This spell functions as remove fatigue, except it fully removes the fatigued and exhausted condition from the target.
